dialogue.content: （こんにちは）
dialogue.English: (Hello.)

dialogue.content: こんにちは。今日はよろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Hello. Thank you for your time today.

dialogue.content: （宜しくお願いいたします）
dialogue.English: (Thank you as well.)

dialogue.content: （少し早いですが、始めさせていただいてよろしいですか？）
dialogue.English: (It's a little early, but may we begin?)

dialogue.content: はい、お願いいたします
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。今日はどんなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 妻とのことで悩んでいます
dialogue.English: I'm having some issues with my wife.

dialogue.content: パートナーさんとのことが気がかりでいらっしゃるのですね。お話聞かせていただきますので、出来る範囲でお名前と性別、ご年齢を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: I see, you're concerned about your partner. I'm here to listen. To the extent you're comfortable, could you please tell me your name, gender, and age?

dialogue.content: 30代男性、しん”です
dialogue.English: I'm a man in my 30s, and my name is Shin.

dialogue.content: しんさん、ありがとうございます。パートナーさんとはどんな事でお悩みでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you, Shin. What specifically is troubling you about your partner?

dialogue.content: はい、妻がコロナで神経質になっていて、嫌になってしまいます
dialogue.English: Yes, my wife has become overly anxious about COVID, and it's getting to me.

dialogue.content: なるほど、どんなことを細かくおっしゃるのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. Could you tell me in more detail what kinds of things she says?

dialogue.content: まず家に帰ったら、外で上着を脱いで、入ったら消毒をしてから、所定の位置に上着をかける
dialogue.English: First, when I get home, I have to take off my jacket outside, then sanitize as soon as I come in, and hang my jacket in its designated spot.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: それから手を洗って、うがい、
dialogue.English: Then I have to wash my hands, and gargle.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 風呂は最後、飯も別々に食わされる
dialogue.English: I have to bathe last, and I'm made to eat my meals separately.

dialogue.content: そこにマスク置くな、すぐ消毒、
dialogue.English: "Don't put your mask there." "Disinfect that right now."

dialogue.content: はい、たくさんの手順ですね、大変です
dialogue.English: I see, that's a lot of steps. That must be difficult.

dialogue.content: いい加減にしてほしい
dialogue.English: I just wish she would give it a rest.

dialogue.content: それは、お疲れの時に指示されると嫌なお気持ちになられますよね。
dialogue.English: I can imagine it must be unpleasant to be ordered around like that when you're tired.

dialogue.content: 聴いてきたことはうのみにして
dialogue.English: She just blindly believes everything she hears.

dialogue.content: 何でも言う通りにしないと気が済まない
dialogue.English: And she's not satisfied unless I do exactly as she says.

dialogue.content: ああ、うのみにして情報が何だかわからなくてもやってしまうように見えるんですね
dialogue.English: Ah, so it seems like she blindly accepts information and acts on it without really understanding it.

dialogue.content: そうなんです。ママ友の誰誰もそう言っていた、とかって
dialogue.English: Exactly. She'll say things like, "So-and-so from my moms' group said so."

dialogue.content: 辛酸のご家庭はお二人暮らしですか？
dialogue.English: Is it just the two of you living in your home, Shinsan?

dialogue.content: しんさんです、たいへんもうしわけありません
dialogue.English: I mean Shin-san, my apologies.

dialogue.content: 小2の娘がいて、すっかり私はのけ者扱いです
dialogue.English: We have a daughter in second grade, and I'm treated like a complete outcast.

dialogue.content: お嬢様がいらっしゃるので、しんさんは別のサイクル扱いとなってしまわれる・・・淋しいとか少し苛立ちもお感じになるかもしれませんね。
dialogue.English: Since you have a daughter, it seems you're being treated on a separate schedule... That might make you feel lonely or a bit frustrated.

dialogue.content: 絶対この子にはうつさないでって、かかってもいないのに！
dialogue.English: She says, "You absolutely cannot infect her," even though I'm not even sick!

dialogue.content: 最近は、娘まで似た様になっています
dialogue.English: Recently, even my daughter has started acting the same way.

dialogue.content: 「絶対この子にはうつさないで」なんて、決めつけて言われたらいやな気持ちがされますよね！お嬢様はやはり、ママの事が生活のお手本ですものね、なおさらつまらない思いをしてしまいますね。
dialogue.English: It must be upsetting to be told something so definitively like, "You absolutely cannot infect her!" And of course, your daughter looks to her mother as a role model, which must make things even more frustrating for you.

dialogue.content: 学校は休校はしていないのですが
dialogue.English: The school isn't closed, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 娘が不安になって、学校に行こうとしなくなりました
dialogue.English: My daughter has become anxious and doesn't want to go to school anymore.

dialogue.content: ああ、お嬢様もコロナをこわがっていらっしゃるんですね。。。
dialogue.English: Ah, so your daughter is also afraid of COVID...

dialogue.content: 私は言ってもいいと思うんですが、妻が簡単に休めっていうんです
dialogue.English: I think it's fine for her to go, but my wife just tells her to stay home.

dialogue.content: 行っても、です
dialogue.English: I meant, go to school.

dialogue.content: きりがない話だと思うんですよね
dialogue.English: I feel like there's no end to it.

dialogue.content: はい、読めています(^^)なるほど、しんさんは学校に登校するのが大切だと思われるけれど、パートナーさんは休ませてしまう。
dialogue.English: Yes, I follow you. I see—you think it's important for her to go to school, but your partner has her stay home.

dialogue.content: そうですね、線引きが私たち専門家で無い者には難しいですね。
dialogue.English: That's true, it's difficult for us non-experts to know where to draw the line.

dialogue.content: しんさんのお仕事は毎日勤務できているのでしょうか？テレワークなどでお家にいることも多いですか？
dialogue.English: Are you able to go to work every day, Shin? Or are you working from home a lot?

dialogue.content: おかげさまで変わらず出勤しています。だいたい、食っていかなきゃならないのに、毎日かえっていきなり矢継ぎ早に言われて頭にくる
dialogue.English: Thankfully, I've been going to work as usual. I mean, I have to work to put food on the table, and it's infuriating to be bombarded with demands the moment I get home every day.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、しんさんだってコロナが怖くない訳でないのに、お仕事に通われているのに「帰宅していきなり矢継ぎ早に言われ」たら、頭にくるのは当然のお気持ちだと思います！
dialogue.English: That makes sense. It's not as if you're unafraid of COVID, yet you're still commuting to work—being hit with rapid-fire demands the moment you get home would naturally make you angry.

dialogue.content: まったく、だれが稼いでると思ってるんだか…代われるわけでもないのに
dialogue.English: Seriously, who does she think is earning the money... It's not like she can do it instead.

dialogue.content: お\パートナーさんは専業主婦なんですね
dialogue.English: So your partner is a full-time homemaker, then.

dialogue.content: はい、だからテレビとママ友ネットワークで日々強化してます
dialogue.English: Yes, so her views are reinforced daily by TV and her network of mom friends.

dialogue.content: なるほど、情報源が限られているからパートナーさんは少し偏った知識になっておられるかもしれないとご心配ですよね
dialogue.English: I see—you’re concerned that because her sources of information are limited, your partner’s knowledge might be a bit skewed.

dialogue.content: ここまで聞かせていただいた内容を少し整理しますね。
dialogue.English: Let me try to summarize what you've told me so far.

dialogue.content: 専業主婦のパートナーさんはコロナ対策を完璧にしたいと言う思いから、しんさんが疲れて帰宅したのに矢継ぎ早に消毒や食事、お風呂の順番まで指示をしてくる。この頃はお嬢様まで、不安に共鳴して学校をお休みしている。パートナーさんはママ友からの話をうのみにしているようで根拠のない話もあるようなのに、指示がましい毎日は頭に来てしまう。
dialogue.English: Your partner, a full-time homemaker, wants to perfect your COVID precautions, so even when you come home tired she gives rapid-fire instructions about sanitizing, meals, and even bathing order. Lately your daughter has echoed that anxiety and has been staying home from school. Your partner seems to take what her mom friends say at face value, even when the information may lack a sound basis, and the daily bossiness is infuriating.

dialogue.content: はい、ちょっと視野を広げてほしいですよね
dialogue.English: Yes, I just wish she would broaden her perspective a bit.

dialogue.content: パートナーさんのプレッシャーがしんさんのお疲れを上増ししているようで、お辛い気持だろうなと感じています
dialogue.English: It sounds like the pressure from your partner is adding to your fatigue, and I can sense how difficult that must be for you.

dialogue.content: しんさんはパートナーさんの感染症対策全般については、良いと思われますか？私はお嬢様もいらっしゃるので、敏感になられる事は大切でもあるとは思うのですが。
dialogue.English: Overall, do you feel your partner’s infection-control measures are good? Since you have a daughter, I do think some vigilance is important.

dialogue.content: 言いたいことはわかるけど、やり過ぎだと思う家でくらい、寛ぎたいよ
dialogue.English: I understand what she's getting at, but I think it's overkill. I just want to be able to relax at home.

dialogue.content: ただ、パートナーさんの「押し付け」や「指示・命令」のような態度には納得できないしんさんのお気持ちが当然だと思っています
dialogue.English: However, I think it's completely natural for you to feel that you can't accept your partner's "pushy" or "demanding" attitude.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、おくつろぎになりたいですよね
dialogue.English: Of course, you want to be able to relax.

dialogue.content: 家でまでストレス溜めたくないよ
dialogue.English: I don't want to get stressed out at home, too.

dialogue.content: いきなり上から言われるのは、カチンとくるよね
dialogue.English: Being talked down to out of the blue really ticks me off.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、お仕事で立派にご家族を養われているのに、疲れてしまいますよね。これからどうしたらしんさんも寛げて、ご家族の健康も守って行けるのかご一緒に方法を考えてみましょう！
dialogue.English: That’s understandable—you’re working hard to support your family, and it’s exhausting. Let’s think together about how you can relax while still protecting your family’s health.

dialogue.content: お願いします
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: はい！ご一緒に何ができるか考えましょう！感染症対策は必要で、お嬢様をお守りしたいお気持ちはしんさんもパートナーさんも同じお気持ちのように思うのですが、いかがですか？
dialogue.English: Great—let’s consider what can be done together. Infection control is necessary, and it seems both you and your partner share the desire to protect your daughter. How does that sound?

dialogue.content: それは、基本的なことをやらなきゃいけないし、やっていたらいいと思います。
dialogue.English: Well, I think we should do the basic things, and as long as we're doing them, it should be fine.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。ただ、運営方法（会社みたいですね）が異なる、または間違っているとしんさんはお感じだと思います。
dialogue.English: Right. It sounds like you feel the way things are being 'run' (almost like a company) is different from what you’d want, or not quite right.

dialogue.content: まあ、そうかな
dialogue.English: Well, I suppose so.

dialogue.content: 更に、パートナーさんの「指示がましい」「押し付け」は聞き入れることが出来ない気持ちですよね、当然だと思います。
dialogue.English: Furthermore, it's completely natural to feel that you can't accept your partner's "bossy" and "pushy" attitude.

dialogue.content: っそもそも、なんで命令？
dialogue.English: In the first place, why is she ordering me around?

dialogue.content: 優しく迎えてほしいよ
dialogue.English: I just want her to welcome me home kindly.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、一緒に家庭を築くなかまですものね。私でもカチンとくると思います！もう一つ、お嬢様の登校についてはしんさんは社会人としての視点から行かせた方が良いと感じていらっしゃる
dialogue.English: Of course, you're partners building a home together. I would be annoyed too! Another point is that regarding your daughter's schooling, you feel from your perspective as a working adult that it's better for her to go.

dialogue.content: 行かないのはかえって、不安だと思うんだけど。
dialogue.English: I think not going would actually make her more anxious.

dialogue.content: そのご心配はもっともな事です。
dialogue.English: That's a very valid concern.

dialogue.content: お嬢様の将来をご心配な事はパートナーさんも同じだとは思いますが、方向性が違ってしまっているのかなと感じます。
dialogue.English: I believe your partner is also concerned about your daughter's future, but it seems your approaches are just different.

dialogue.content: そうですよね
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: いま、ご一緒に見つけた課題を短くまとめると、・感染症対策は理解しているが「命令」みたいに指示して来るのでなく、「説明」や「同意を求める」よう、家庭では優しく迎えて欲しい。・お嬢様の登校については学業た、将来の進学を検討の余地に入れた方が良いのではないか
dialogue.English: To briefly summarize the issues we've identified together: - You understand the need for infection control, but you want to be welcomed home kindly, with "explanations" or "requests for agreement" instead of being ordered around. - Regarding your daughter's schooling, you feel her studies and future education should be taken into consideration.

dialogue.content: の2点がまずパートナーさんとすり合わせ出来たら良いのかなと思うのですが、いかがですか？
dialogue.English: I think it would be good if you could first come to an understanding with your partner on these two points. What do you think?

dialogue.content: そうですよね、加えて、娘のことに関しては、わざわざ不安にさせているみたいになっているのが気になります
dialogue.English: That's right. In addition, regarding my daughter, I'm concerned that she's being made to feel unnecessarily anxious.

dialogue.content: ああ、なるほど、必要以上に怖がらせるのは良くないとお考えですね、わかる気がします。
dialogue.English: Ah, I see. You believe it's not good to frighten her more than necessary. I can understand that.

dialogue.content: 自信とまではいかなくても、もっと強くあってもいいと思うんですよね
dialogue.English: I don't mean she has to be brimming with confidence, but I think she could be a little stronger.

dialogue.content: 強くなってるとこが違うと思っています
dialogue.English: I think the way she's becoming strong is misguided.

dialogue.content: はい、そうですね、「不安で閉じこもってばかりが良いわけではない」と思われるお立場も大切だと思います。しんさんが気になる今日まとめたポイントを「冷静に（穏やかに）」パートナーさんに説明できれば、関係性を変える事が出来ると思います！
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right. Your position that "it's not good to just shut oneself away in anxiety" is also important. If you can calmly and gently explain the points we've summarized today that concern you to your partner, I believe you can change your relationship.

dialogue.content: できますかね？
dialogue.English: Do you think I can do that?

dialogue.content: そして、しんさんはご家族を大切に思われているので、気持ちは理解してもらえると思います！
dialogue.English: And because you care deeply about your family, I believe she will understand your feelings.

dialogue.content: はい！
dialogue.English: Yes!

dialogue.content: 口では勝てそうもありませんが、どうしたらいいですか？
dialogue.English: I don't think I can win in an argument with her. What should I do?

dialogue.content: ただ、ご夫婦の話し合いって一般的には「照れ」や「マウントの取り合い」になりがちだと思うんです（笑）
dialogue.English: Well, discussions between couples often tend to involve "awkwardness" or "a power struggle." (laughs)

dialogue.content: マウント？
dialogue.English: A power struggle?

dialogue.content: はい、「どちらが主導権を握るか」の取り合いといえばよいでしょうか
dialogue.English: Yes, a struggle over "who has the upper hand," so to speak.

dialogue.content: ああ・・・
dialogue.English: Ah...

dialogue.content: ただ、しんさんとパートナーさんは思いは同じだけれどもやり方がかみ合っていないと感じていることが理解し合えたら、
dialogue.English: However, if you and your partner can understand that you both feel the same way but your methods just aren't aligning,

dialogue.content: 今日からパートナーさんも違ったやり方を取り入れてくださると思います
dialogue.English: I believe your partner will be open to trying a different approach starting today.

dialogue.content: 理解しあえるといいです
dialogue.English: I hope we can understand each other.

dialogue.content: そこで、話し合いの方法でご提案なのですが、家庭とは違う場所で話し合う（カフェや公園など）またはお手紙で伝えるなどあると思うのですが、どちらのやり方の方が現実的ですか？
dialogue.English: With that in mind, may I suggest ways to have the conversation: talking somewhere outside the home (like a café or a park), or conveying your thoughts in a letter. Which seems more realistic for you?

dialogue.content: 外は難しいかもしれないから。、得意でもない手紙の方かな…
dialogue.English: Going out might be difficult, so maybe a letter—even though I'm not good at writing them…

dialogue.content: 違った空間に移動すると、ご自宅にいる時より客観的になれます。また、わざわざ手紙を書くという労力をかけたと言う事で真剣さが伝わると思います。
dialogue.English: Moving to a different space can help you both be more objective than when you're at home. Also, the effort of writing a letter will convey your seriousness.

dialogue.content: そうですか、お手紙は得意でないことをあえて頑張ったことにさらなる真剣さが伝わると思います！
dialogue.English: I see. The fact that you’d make the effort to write even though it isn’t your strength will further convey your sincerity.

dialogue.content: では、まず第一歩として「手紙でしんさんの感じていることを伝える作戦」をやってみましょう！
dialogue.English: Then, as a first step, let’s try the strategy of conveying how you feel in a letter.

dialogue.content: わかりました、ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Understood. Thank you.

dialogue.content: その話し合いの扉が開けば、学校の事、危うい情報の事も話し合っていけると思います！
dialogue.English: Once that door to dialogue opens, I think you can also talk about school and questionable information.

dialogue.content: そしてまたお困りになったらご相談ください！ここで今日は時間となりますが、話足りないことは無いですか？
dialogue.English: And please come back if you run into any more trouble. Our time is up for today, but is there anything else you wanted to talk about?

dialogue.content: はい、大丈夫ですありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: No, I'm fine. Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。コロナを乗り越えて楽しく暮らすしんさんのご家庭が目に浮かびます！頑張ってください！（少し長引いてすいませんでした。勉強になりました。ありがとうございました）
dialogue.English: Thank you. I can picture your family overcoming COVID and living happily! I'm wishing you the best. (I'm sorry we went a little over time. This was a learning experience for me. Thank you.)

dialogue.content: （大変勉強になりました。ありがとうございました。）
dialogue.English: (This was a great learning experience. Thank you very much.)

dialogue.content: （ロープレありがとうございました）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for the role-play.)
